description: A row asks to open or close its children (at any depth). event.id and event.tag name the row; event.expanded is the state the press asks for; the group applies it itself.

id.description: The id of the item the event came from (empty if it has none).

tag.description: The tag of the item the event came from.

expanded.description: The state the press asks for: true opens the row, false closes it.
